Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
I was just poking around in the Monger and had a pair of quick questions about
the texts of two cards.

#1. Is the superior version of Preternatural Evasion considered S:CE? It says
"SUP: Strike: this vampire burns 1 blood to end combat." But it doesn't
actually say "combat ends" or anything.

#2. This is probably intuitive for most people but just to make sure, exactly
what does the "third counter" on Dreams of the Sphinx mean? I know it usually
means you use it two times and then the next time you use it, it burns. But
let's say you use the Dreams and then use a Goth Band to move a counter. The
Dreams only has one counter now, but would it burn if you used it? It's the
third counter that has been added, but I'm not sure if that is the same thing
as "when the third counter is added" in this case.

Thanks!

Halcyan 2

>

Each time you put a counter, you check if it is the 3rd on the card -this
effectively burning Dreams of the Sphinx. If you find a way to move the
counters -and Goth band is such a fine way, you can use it for a longer time
(of course someone will rush the Goth band when they see you gain 1 extra
blood & transfer each turn...)
The problem is : Goth band can only take counters from opponent to put it on
your Dreams of the Sphinx. So, the solution is : someone has to do this for
you. Maybe you can make a deal using succubus club, so an other player can
use your goth band to remove counters from your DotS to his Ventrue
investment or Spawning pool...
seems difficult though.

reyda
